{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"Graffiticode API","version":"1.0.0","summary":"Make interactive content from a plain-English description.","description":"Graffiticode turns a natural-language description into interactive
content — quizzes and assessment items, flashcards, spreadsheets, charts,
surveys, concept webs and more — each made by a specialist language.

The usual flow:

1. `GET /languages` to find the language for the job (or pass your best
   guess: the platform re-routes a request another language fits better).
2. `POST /items` with a description. Generation runs asynchronously: the
   response is `202 Accepted` with a `Location`.
3. `GET /items/{id}` (with `Prefer: wait=N` to long-poll) until `status` is
   `ready`, then open its `view_url`.
4. `POST /items/{id}/revisions` to change it by describing the change.

Descriptions must be written in English; content inside an item may be in
any language.

Errors are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457). A problem's `type` is
`https://openapi.graffiticode.org/problems/<code>`.

GET /v1/openapi.yaml.body:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Graffiticode API
  version: 1.0.0
  summary: Make interactive content from a plain-English description.
  description: |
    Graffiticode turns a natural-language description into interactive
    content — quizzes and assessment items, flashcards, spreadsheets, charts,
    surveys, concept webs and more — each made by a specialist language.

    The usual flow:

    1. `GET /languages` to find the language for the job (or pass your best
       guess: the platform re-routes a request another language fits better).
    2. `POST /items` with a description. Generation runs asynchronously: the
       response is `202 Accepted` with a `Location`.
    3. `GET /items/{id}` (with `Prefer: wait=N` to long-poll) until `status` is
       `ready`, then open its `view_url`.
    4. `POST /items/{id}/revisions` to change it by describing the change.

    Descriptions must be written in English; content inside an item may be in
    any language.

    Errors are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457). A problem's `type` is
    `https://openapi.graffiticode.org/problems/<code>`.
  contact:
    name: Graffiticode
    url: https://graffiticode.org
servers:
  - url: https://openapi.graffiticode.org/v1
security:
  - {}
  - bearerAuth: []
  - oauth2:
      - graffiticode
  - workspaceToken: []
tags:
  - name: languages
    description: The catalog of Graffiticode languages.
  - name: items
    description: The content you make.
  - name: account
    description: Workspaces and your account.
  - name: skills
    description: Agent skills — guidance for working with Graffiticode well.
  - name: meta
    description: This API's own description and health.
paths:
  /languages:
    get:
      operationId: list_languages
      tags:
        - languages
      summary: List languages
      description: |
        The languages an agent should choose from, most relevant first when
        `search` is given. Internal and retired languages are not listed, but
        remain usable by id.
      parameters:
        - name: search
          in: query
          description: Words describing what you want to make.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 200
        - name: domain
          in: query
          description: Only languages in this domain (e.g. `assessment`).
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 64
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/cursor"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A page of languages.
          headers:
            ETag:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/ETag"
            Cache-Control:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Cache-Control"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/LanguagePage"
        "304":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotModified"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
  /languages/{id}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/languageId"
    get:
      operationId: get_language_info
      tags:
        - languages
      summary: Get a language
      description: How to author for a language, what it is for, and what it is not for.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The language.
          headers:
            ETag:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/ETag"
            Cache-Control:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Cache-Control"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/LanguageInfo"
        "304":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotModified"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
  /languages/{id}/guide:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/languageId"
    get:
      operationId: get_language_guide
      tags:
        - languages
      summary: Get a language's user guide
      description: The full authoring reference for a language, as markdown.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The guide.
          headers:
            ETag:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/ETag"
            Cache-Control:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Cache-Control"
          content:
            text/markdown:
              schema:
                type: string
        "304":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotModified"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
  /skills:
    get:
      operationId: list_skills
      tags:
        - skills
      summary: List agent skills
      description: Guidance for agents working with Graffiticode, read from the public
        graffiticode-app repository (packages/skills).
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The skills.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Cache-Control"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Skill"
        "503":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unavailable"
  /skills/{id}:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,100}$
    get:
      operationId: get_skill
      tags:
        - skills
      summary: Get an agent skill
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The skill, as markdown.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Cache-Control"
          content:
            text/markdown:
              schema:
                type: string
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "503":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unavailable"
  /items:
    get:
      operationId: list_items
      tags:
        - items
      summary: List your items
      description: Newest first. On the free plan, the items in your workspace.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      parameters:
        - name: language
          in: query
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/LanguageIdParam"
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemStatus"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/cursor"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A page of items.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemPage"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
    post:
      operationId: create_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Create an item
      description: |
        Starts generating an item from a description. Returns `202` at once,
        with the item (`status: generating`) and its `Location`; poll that
        (`Prefer: wait=N`) or follow its events until `ready`.

        To put several items in the same free-plan workspace, pass the previous
        item's id as `source_item_id`. When that moves you to another
        workspace, the new handle is in the `Graffiticode-Workspace` header.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateItemRequest"
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/idempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "202":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Generating"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "402":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/LimitReached"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "422":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/IdempotencyKeyReused"
        "429":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"
  /items/{id}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: get_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Get an item
      description: |
        `status` is `generating`, `ready` or `failed`. While generating, send
        `Prefer: wait=N` (N ≤ 45) to wait up to N seconds for it to finish.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      parameters:
        - name: Prefer
          in: header
          description: "`wait=N`, N seconds (0–45), per RFC 7240."
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 200
        - name: include
          in: query
          description: Also return the item's `src` and/or compiled `data`
            (comma-separated).
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: ^(src|data)(,(src|data))?$
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The item.
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Retry-After"
            Preference-Applied:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Preference-Applied"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Item"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "410":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone"
    patch:
      operationId: rename_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Rename an item
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/merge-patch+json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemPatch"
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemPatch"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The renamed item.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Item"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
    delete:
      operationId: archive_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Archive an item
      description: A soft delete — the item leaves your listings; its id keeps working.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Archived.
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
  /items/{id}/revisions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    post:
      operationId: update_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Revise an item
      description: |
        Changes an item by describing the change. Returns `202`; follow the
        item as for a create. Refused with `409` while it is still generating.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RevisionRequest"
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/idempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "202":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Generating"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "402":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/LimitReached"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "410":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone"
        "429":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/TooManyRequests"
    get:
      operationId: list_revisions
      tags:
        - items
      summary: List an item's versions
      description: Each content state the item has had, newest first. Needs a full account.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/limit"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The versions.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - data
                additionalProperties: false
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Revision"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "422":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/IdempotencyKeyReused"
  /items/{id}/retry:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    post:
      operationId: retry_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Retry a failed generation
      description: For an item whose `error.retryable` is true. Starts the same change
        again.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/idempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "202":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Generating"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "422":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/IdempotencyKeyReused"
  /items/{id}/src:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: get_item_src
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Get an item's source
      description: The program, in the item's language. Private to that language — to
        move content to another language, use `/spec`.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The source.
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
  /items/{id}/data:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: get_item_data
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Get an item's compiled data
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The compiled data.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {}
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
  /items/{id}/spec:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: get_spec
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Get an item's platform-neutral spec
      description: |
        A plain-English description of the item's content. To make it into
        another language, pass this text after one line of intent as a new
        item's description. It starts with a blank line on purpose: that keeps
        the content separate from your request however you join them.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The spec.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Spec"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "503":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unavailable"
  /items/{id}/view:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: render_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Open an item
      description: Redirects to the item's interactive view.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "303":
          description: See the view.
          headers:
            Location:
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
  /items/{id}/embed:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: embed_item
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Embed an item
      description: An oEmbed (`rich`) response with an iframe for the item's view.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      parameters:
        - name: maxwidth
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 200
            maximum: 4000
        - name: maxheight
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 200
            maximum: 4000
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The embed.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Embed"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
  /items/{id}/events:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/itemId"
    get:
      operationId: item_events
      tags:
        - items
      summary: Follow an item's generation
      description: |
        Server-sent events: `progress` while generating, then one `ready`
        (with the item) or `failed` (with the error), after which the stream
        ends. A comment is sent every 15 seconds to keep the connection open.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The event stream.
          content:
            text/event-stream:
              schema:
                type: string
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
  /workspaces:
    post:
      operationId: create_workspace
      tags:
        - account
      summary: Start a free-plan workspace
      description: |
        No account needed. Returns a workspace token to send as
        `X-Graffiticode-Workspace`; items you make with it are kept for 48
        hours, and its `claim_url`s let you keep them by signing up.
      security:
        - {}
      responses:
        "201":
          description: A new workspace.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Workspace"
  /me:
    get:
      operationId: get_me
      tags:
        - account
      summary: Who you are, and what you have left
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
        - oauth2:
            - graffiticode
        - workspaceToken: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Your account.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Me"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
  /openapi.json:
    get:
      operationId: get_openapi_json
      tags:
        - meta
      summary: This description, as JSON
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The OpenAPI document.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      operationId: get_openapi_yaml
      tags:
        - meta
      summary: This description, as YAML
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The OpenAPI document.
          content:
            application/yaml:
              schema:
                type: string
  /docs:
    get:
      operationId: get_docs
      tags:
        - meta
      summary: Interactive documentation
      responses:
        "200":
          description: An HTML page rendering this description.
          content:
            text/html:
              schema:
                type: string
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: A Graffiticode API key, created in the console under Settings.
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      description: |
        Sign in with a Graffiticode account (authorization code with PKCE).
        Clients register at https://mcp.graffiticode.org/oauth/register
        (RFC 7591); tokens are issued for the resource
        https://openapi.graffiticode.org/v1, named in the authorization URL.
      flows:
        authorizationCode:
          authorizationUrl: https://mcp.graffiticode.org/oauth/authorize?resource=https%3A%2F%2Fopenapi.graffiticode.org%2Fv1
          tokenUrl: https://mcp.graffiticode.org/oauth/token
          refreshUrl: https://mcp.graffiticode.org/oauth/token
          scopes:
            graffiticode: Create and edit your items.
    workspaceToken:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Graffiticode-Workspace
      description: |
        A free-plan workspace, from `POST /workspaces`. Send it back on every
        request; when the platform moves you to another workspace the new
        handle comes back in the `Graffiticode-Workspace` response header.
  parameters:
    languageId:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      description: A language id such as `L0180` (the `L` is optional).
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[Ll]?[0-9]{4}$
    limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      description: Page size.
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 25
    idempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      description: |
        Makes retrying this request safe: the same key (within 24 hours) gets
        the original response — marked `Idempotent-Replayed: true` — and never
        a second item or generation.
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[\x21-\x7e]{1,255}$
    itemId:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$
    cursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      description: Opaque; from a previous page's `next_cursor`.
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,512}$
  headers:
    ETag:
      description: Entity tag for conditional requests (`If-None-Match`).
      schema:
        type: string
    Cache-Control:
      schema:
        type: string
    Retry-After:
      description: Seconds to wait before checking again.
      schema:
        type: integer
    Preference-Applied:
      schema:
        type: string
    Graffiticode-Workspace:
      description: Your free-plan workspace handle, when it changed. Send it as
        `X-Graffiticode-Workspace` from now on.
      schema:
        type: string
  responses:
    NotModified:
      description: Unchanged since the `If-None-Match` tag.
    Generating:
      description: Accepted; generating. Follow `Location`.
      headers:
        Idempotent-Replayed:
          description: Present (`true`) when this is the stored response to an earlier
            request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.
          schema:
            type: string
        Location:
          schema:
            type: string
        Retry-After:
          $ref: "#/components/headers/Retry-After"
        Graffiticode-Workspace:
          $ref: "#/components/headers/Graffiticode-Workspace"
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Item"
    Unauthorized:
      description: Credentials are missing or not valid.
      headers:
        WWW-Authenticate:
          schema:
            type: string
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    Forbidden:
      description: Not allowed for this account (for example, a full-account feature
        on the free plan).
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    LimitReached:
      description: A plan limit was reached; `upgrade_url` says how to go on.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    TooManyRequests:
      description: Too many requests; retry after `Retry-After` seconds.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          $ref: "#/components/headers/Retry-After"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    Conflict:
      description: |
        The item can't take this now: `generation_in_progress` (retry after
        `Retry-After`), `item_changed`, `not_ready`, or `not_retryable`.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          $ref: "#/components/headers/Retry-After"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    IdempotencyKeyReused:
      description: This `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different request.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    Gone:
      description: A free-plan item past its time limit.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    BadRequest:
      description: The request doesn't match this description.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    NotFound:
      description: Not found.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
    Unavailable:
      description: Temporarily unavailable; retry after `Retry-After` seconds.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          schema:
            type: integer
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem"
  schemas:
    Problem:
      type: object
      description: RFC 9457 problem details.
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
        code:
          type: string
          description: Stable machine-readable reason.
        errors:
          type: array
          description: For validation problems, where the request failed.
          items:
            type: object
            required:
              - pointer
              - message
            properties:
              pointer:
                type: string
                description: JSON pointer into the request.
              message:
                type: string
      additionalProperties: true
    Language:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - description
        - domains
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          pattern: ^L[0-9]{4}$
          examples:
            - L0180
        name:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        when_to_use:
          type: string
        domains:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
    LanguagePage:
      type: object
      required:
        - data
        - next_cursor
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        data:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Language"
        next_cursor:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.
    ExamplePrompt:
      type: object
      required:
        - prompt
      properties:
        prompt:
          type: string
        produces:
          type: string
        notes:
          type: string
    LanguageInfo:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - description
        - domains
        - authoring_guide
        - supported_item_types
        - not_for
        - example_prompts
        - guide_url
        - spec_url
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          pattern: ^L[0-9]{4}$
        name:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        when_to_use:
          type: string
        domains:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        authoring_guide:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        supported_item_types:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        not_for:
          type: array
          description: What this language is not for — the strongest signal to pick another.
          items:
            type: string
        example_prompts:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ExamplePrompt"
        guide_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: The full user guide (markdown).
        spec_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
    Skill:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - description
        - url
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
    LanguageIdParam:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[Ll]?[0-9]{4}$
    ItemStatus:
      type: string
      enum:
        - generating
        - ready
        - failed
    CreateItemRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - language
        - description
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        language:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/LanguageIdParam"
        description:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20000
          description: What to make, in English. Be specific about content, structure and
            look.
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 200
        source_item_id:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$
          description: An item you made earlier, so this one joins its free-plan workspace.
    RevisionRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - modification
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        modification:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20000
          description: What to change, in English.
    ItemPatch:
      type: object
      required:
        - name
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 200
    ItemError:
      type: object
      required:
        - message
      properties:
        message:
          type: string
        code:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        retryable:
          type: boolean
          description: True when `POST /items/{id}/retry` can start it again.
    LastWrite:
      type: object
      description: The latest write of this item's content to your connected item bank
        (read-only).
      required:
        - task_id
        - connection_id
        - status
        - at
        - checkable
      properties:
        task_id:
          type: string
        connection_id:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - ok
            - failed
            - skipped
        message:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        confirmed:
          type:
            - boolean
            - "null"
        checkable:
          type: boolean
        reconcile:
          type:
            - object
            - "null"
          properties:
            verdict:
              type: string
            text:
              type: string
            at:
              type: string
              format: date-time
    Item:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - language
        - status
        - created
        - updated
        - view_url
        - links
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        language:
          type: string
          pattern: ^L[0-9]{4}$
        status:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemStatus"
        error:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ItemError"
        progress:
          type: object
          description: While generating.
          properties:
            chars:
              type: integer
            elapsed_s:
              type: integer
        created:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
        updated:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
        view_url:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: uri
          description: Where to open the item, once ready.
        claim_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Free plan — sign up and keep this workspace's items.
        last_write:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/LastWrite"
        src:
          type: string
          description: With `include=src`.
        data:
          description: With `include=data`.
        links:
          type: object
          required:
            - self
            - view
            - spec
            - events
            - revisions
          properties:
            self:
              type: string
              format: uri
            view:
              type: string
              format: uri
            spec:
              type: string
              format: uri
            events:
              type: string
              format: uri
            revisions:
              type: string
              format: uri
    ItemPage:
      type: object
      required:
        - data
        - next_cursor
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        data:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Item"
        next_cursor:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
    Revision:
      type: object
      required:
        - task_id
        - created
        - source
      properties:
        task_id:
          type: string
        created:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        source:
          type: string
        label:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
    Spec:
      type: object
      required:
        - item_id
        - language
        - spec
        - coverage_checked
        - coverage_missing
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        item_id:
          type: string
        language:
          type: string
          pattern: ^L[0-9]{4}$
        spec:
          type: string
        coverage_checked:
          type: integer
          description: Source strings checked for in the spec.
        coverage_missing:
          type: array
          description: Source strings the spec left out.
          items:
            type: string
    Embed:
      type: object
      required:
        - version
        - type
        - html
        - width
        - height
      properties:
        version:
          const: "1.0"
        type:
          const: rich
        title:
          type: string
        provider_name:
          type: string
        provider_url:
          type: string
        html:
          type: string
        width:
          type: integer
        height:
          type: integer
    Workspace:
      type: object
      required:
        - workspace
        - expires_at
      properties:
        workspace:
          type: string
          description: Send as `X-Graffiticode-Workspace`.
        expires_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        usage:
          type: string
    Me:
      type: object
      required:
        - account
      properties:
        account:
          type: string
          enum:
            - user
            - free_plan
        plan:
          type: object
          required:
            - id
            - name
          properties:
            id:
              type: string
            name:
              type: string
        usage:
          type: object
          properties:
            items_this_period:
              type: integer
            included_items:
              type:
                - integer
                - "null"
            available_items:
              type:
                - integer
                - "null"
              description: Null when uncapped.
            period_ends_at:
              type:
                - string
                - "null"
              format: date-time
        free_plan:
          type: object
          properties:
            item_ttl_hours:
              type: integer
            languages:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            signup_url:
              type: string
              format: uri
